name: io.github.EzkielynaGroup/ezkielyna-audio-mcp
title: Ezkielyna Audio
description: Text to speech and speech to text from local audio files via the Ezkielyna API (prepaid key).

environmentVariables.name: EZKIELYNA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Ezkielyna API key (Auto group, or a group that lists the audio models)

environmentVariables.name: EZKIELYNA_AUDIO_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder where speech files are saved (default ~/Music/Ezkielyna)
